main_text.p: ducia, atque fidei in effusum AGNI DEI sanguinem. Liberè namq; profitemur, nobis in Christo, qui est nostra Justitia, Sanctitas, Redemptio, Via, Veritas, Sapientia & Vita, omnia dono esse data: atq; adeò à Credentibus opera, non ut satisfaciant pro peccatis suis; sed ideò solummodo præ-stari, ut per ea DEO Domino nostro, pro ingenti -Beneficio nobis in Christo collato, se aliquatenus gratos exhibeant.

page.notes: The small italic lines between the main text and the Greek closing line are faint and only partly legible; the first is marked illegible and the references in the second are read with uncertainty. The faint, inverted and mirrored text below the Greek line (headings "Confessio Helvetica ... de Iustificatione" and "Confessio Basiliensis", with running text) is show-through from the other side of the leaf and is not transcribed.
